items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Now, you recorded with him at one time. ... INTERVIEWEE: Well, Jelly heard a little part on the ... we split up the band or something like that. We both do the recording.

ctx.x: ...they'd egg him on and tell him 'You can't play piano' and...

Oh yeah, he would talk... Oh, he loved to play. Play and sing his numbers. Sure. Jelly was all right if you knew him. Yeah, Jelly Roll contributed a lot to music. Good guy. No dummy. He was not a dummy at all.
Now, you recorded with him at one time.
